claim_boundary: A proposal for a separately validated numerical boundary-model case. It is not a solver request, Q-N result, or production approval.

failed_candidates: normal_support_repair_001: distanceh=3, svshapes=true; 15751/395911 fixed rows lacked usable native normals.
normal_support_repair_002: only GeometryForNormals vdp values changed to zero; 112031/395911 fixed rows lacked usable native normals.
motivation.interpretation: The second bounded representation change did not close the mDBC native normal gate. A boundary-model alternative is therefore preferable to another blind virtual-normal retry.

evidence.finding: XML Boundary value 1 selects BC_DBC and value 2 selects BC_MDBC.
UseNormals is enabled inside the BC_MDBC branch.
Command-line boundary selection accepts DBC/mDBC and sets UseNormals from TBoundary==BC_MDBC.
TBoundary documents 1 as DBC and 2 as mDBC; SlipMode and NoPenetration are mDBC settings.
The official CLI exposes -dbc and -mdbc variants.
CLI parsing maps -dbc to BC_DBC and mDBC options to BC_MDBC.

candidate_change.physical_geometry_and_initial_state: Preserve the finite 3D geometry, 616000 fluid particles, 616.0 kg mass, typed fixed populations, initial state, controls, gravity, and all source hashes from the parent case.

numerical_boundary_change_only.meaning: Use official Dynamic Boundary Condition (DBC) instead of modified Dynamic Boundary Condition (mDBC).

slip_mode.proposal: Keep the source XML byte value only if the parser accepts it, but treat it as non-operative under DBC; independently verify the parsed runtime configuration before any solver launch.
slip_mode.reason: Official source applies SlipMode only in the mDBC branch.

candidate_change.alternative_cli: If root's solver request uses command-line overrides, use the official -dbc option and record the full command/hash; do not combine an unverified XML and CLI override.

required_root_review_gates: Create a new immutable XML/request prefix; do not alter either failed mDBC candidate or their artifacts.
Verify the generated XML and actual solver command resolve to DBC (TBoundary=1) before launch.
Run bounded CPU/native typed-state and wall-coverage checks with no mass rescaling and no normal-based mDBC claim.
Revalidate penetration/no-slip/pressure behavior and all F1 fixed physical observables independently; DBC is a numerical model change, not an equivalence repair.
Keep Q-N and production status unassessed until the separate numerical and scientific gates pass.
